text:
alex_cs: Quick sync — PilotWave cohort: FinEdge, Nimbus, and Cinder reported issues after the latest build. FinEdge says summarization loses earlier context after ~2.5k tokens. Could be KV cache boundary or batching artifact.

maria_cs: Noted. Are there concrete examples? We should collect 2-3 prompt/response pairs per customer and capture which model variant & sequence length.

alex_cs: Yep — asked FinEdge for anonymized snippets. Pasting one they sent (redacted):
```
Prompt: "Summarize the last 5 customer emails about billing disputes."
Response: "Key points: ..." (repeats first 1.2k tokens then drops references to email #3)
Model: open-redwood-v1.6, seq_len: ~3200
```
They say consistency drops when conversations >2k.

ivy_ae: I can push for more examples in my call tomorrow. FinEdge available 2026-03-25 10:00 PT.

sam_pm: @alex_cs can you also capture request rate / batching config? Runtime team suspects batching threshold may evict KV cache. If we get logs with x-calls per min and batch size that'll help.

nora_cs: I've created a tracker doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/pilotwave-feedback-tracker — columns: customer, samples_collected, enablement_date, elevation (eng-runtime/eng-ml). I'll add FinEdge row.

eng-runtime-bot: Notice: recent canary deploy rolled back at 2026-03-23 18:02 UTC. Might correlate. /cc @sam_pm

maria_cs: OK — plan: Ivy to collect 3 anonymized examples + confirm enablement slot. Alex to grab request metadata (model, tokens, batch). Sam to triage with eng-runtime. Nora to keep tracker updated. Can everyone react with :thumbsup: if good?

alex_cs: :thumbsup:

ivy_ae: On it. Will also ask whether they used prefix caching in prod vs test.

sam_pm: Adding eng-runtime on-call to thread. @eng-runtime-oncall please confirm if recent rollback could cause KV eviction misbehavior.

eng-runtime-bot: Paged eng-runtime-oncall. Assigned to @linus_eng. Linus — please advise.

linus_eng: Looking. Can you drop logs of the session id or request ids? If not, give approximate time window. We'll check batching thresholds and kernel selection logs.

nora_cs: Added follow-ups and tentative renewal risk flag for Nimbus (low usage). Notes in tracker.

alex_cs: Thanks all — I'll coordinate the enablement call and push samples by EOD.
